I have family at Glenwood Health Centre & although they have the same limitations in terms of pressures & finances within the NHS service. Their attitude & manner is second to none.

The amount of times I & other patients I know have gone into the practice & stood without a simple acknowledgement, while staff stand blathering, is appalling. I have found the training lacking as at times have gotten differing answers to the same questions or been given conflicting information.

Unable to get an appointment in advance, on the day only, if you manage to get through on the phone.

The cost to get a simple stamp, signature & a few boxes ticked for a claim form for an airline form (due to being ill & unable to fly), was astronomical & made it impossible to do the claim.

I have since moved practice to Glasgow, what a difference. Friendly, helpful, appointments available to book, professional manner. I thought the NHS had just gotten so bad that in general this was how most practices operated. Not the case at all, restored my faith in the system.",null,[0,95]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNEektQc2ZREAE!2m1!1s0x0:0x4f0341b4acd7cd7e!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgICDzKPsfQ%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNEektQc2ZREAE&t=1&entityid=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNEektQc2ZREi0KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdJQ0R6S1BzX1FFEhJDZ3NJNmYyRXNBWVFpSzJfRkEaLAoWQ0lITTBvZ0tFSUNBZ0lDRHpLUHNBdxISQ2dzSTZmMkVzQVlRaUsyX0ZBIhIJAAAAAAAAAAARfs3XrLRBA08qEkNnc0k2ZjJFc0FZUWlLMl9GQQ&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwj6l_m4tK-TAxWJGWMBHZLbLPMQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,2]]]],"0ahUKEwj6l_m4tK-TAxWJGWMBHZLbLPMQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEY3lTRWRNU1d0SGRGOWZSV2hFWkVwR1NYVndUMHgzUzNBeFJXcEVWVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEp4VFVOaldYTnBVV0V3V1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnSUNaeFp6N2JBEAE",["0x0:0x4f0341b4acd7cd7e",null,1694681968472771,1694682184290493,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/102275346735911413674/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Terry Stubbs","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWYfu2LfRzOymg3qHnOpTPmt0MVK0-_6Mi8D19ySX_ZZKmGRgVXjQ=s120-c-rp-mo-ba2-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/102275346735911413674?hl=en"],"102275346735911413674",null,16,23,null,[1,4,1],8,["Local Guide · 16 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwj6l_m4tK-TAxWJGWMBHZLbLPMQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"2 years ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Absolutely appalling medical practice.
